sentence: Past line A the line-up of divisions changed shape somewhat, its centre of weight moved about 25 km south, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past line B the line-up of divisions kept the same shape, its centre of weight stayed put, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past line C the line-up of divisions changed shape somewhat, its centre of weight moved about 56 km south, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past line D the line-up of divisions took a different shape, its centre of weight moved about 54 km south, and divisions mostly kept their places; 16 fewer divisions got past it.
